'''Vona Kwill''' was a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] who lived during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:RebelScoutTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated depictions of Vona Kwill]]
Vona Kwill was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="AED" /><ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

Because Vona Kwill spawned under the generic "rebel_scout" template, Kwill's appearance was randomized under one of six possible depictions. [[Species/Legends|Species]] Vona Kwill could appear as included [[Human/Legends|Humans]] of either gender, a male [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]], a male [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], and a female [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]]. Because the [[W:c:swg:Quest|quest]] dialogue made no mention of Kwill's physical characteristics, the [[canon]]ical species and gender cannot be definitively determined in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity.<ref name="AED" />
